rulings.docket_item: record the round's calibration: rulings by verdict, lens divergence, severity histogram, recomputed from the embedded totals and an independent count over the frozen corpus
rulings.grounds: Every digit recorded here was recomputed rather than copied. The round's own totals close on themselves without residue: seventeen upheld, eight refined, zero refuted and zero escalated sum to the twenty-five rulings reported, and the twenty-five work orders stand one per ruling; the separately reported zero refuted and zero escalated figures agree with the verdict histogram's own zeros. The primary-pass digits close the same way: sixteen support plus thirty-six challenge equals fifty-two verdicts; the two lenses contribute thirteen and three to the support column and thirteen and twenty-three to the challenge column, twenty-six verdicts per lens; and the severity histogram of three high, twenty-five medium and eight low sums to thirty-six, matching the challenge column exactly, so severity is scored over challenges only. Those primary digits are internally consistent but not independently re-derivable inside this attempt's readable set, which carries no primary verdict objects; they are recorded as reported-and-arithmetically-closed, and that limit is disclosed rather than smoothed. The one census this attempt could run independently is over the frozen corpus, counted as objects and not as digits: twenty-six spans cover one hundred fifty-four verses exactly once, with no gap and no double coverage, so the tiling identity survives intact. The five poem parents hold their rows without a single straddling span - four, five, nine, five and three rows, twenty-six in total, every row opening and closing inside one poem - and the highest-order seams stand at the three verse-initial cry openings and at the man-of-affliction first-person onset, tier-1 text signals at four of the five poem starts. Acrostic conformance is tier-1 and holds: the first, second and fourth poems run one letter per verse across the full twenty-two positions, so every seam in them falls on a letter; the third poem runs twenty-two uniform three-verse letter groups, and eight of its nine rows open on a group's first verse and close on a group's last. Exactly one seam cuts inside a group - between the second and third verse of the sixteenth letter of the third poem, which in that poem's reversed order is pe at position sixteen with ayin following at seventeen, against the first poem's ayin at sixteen and pe at seventeen - and both rows on that seam carry the cut as an explicit disclosure with a named tier-1 ground, the first-person plural turning singular at the group's third verse; that places the cut inside the spine law's disclosed exception, weighed from both sides, and not as a spine breach. Confidence stands at seven high, nine medium, ten medium-low and zero low; no span covers a whole poem, so the whole-chapter cap is engaged on zero rows. Seven of the eight closed category values are in use across seven, five, four, three, three, three and one rows, the acrostic-stanza value unused at zero rows. No string in any row carries an unexpanded brace token. One count-object difference does not reconcile and is recorded open rather than repaired: thirty-six challenge verdicts against twenty-five rulings leaves eleven challenges without a one-to-one ruling, because the two figures count different objects - individual primary verdicts against consolidated docket items - and no readable source in this attempt can map the consolidation. The reported zero sample defects likewise has no independent check available here and is recorded as reported. Nothing above edits a row, decides a held-open literary question, or issues a sweep.
